title: Go to Definition
summary: Jumps the editor caret to the declaration of the symbol under the cursor
intro: Read this to jump straight to where the symbol under the cursor is declared. Choose drag-lint > Go to Definition; the plugin asks the drag-lint language server, so the project needs an index, and a pick list appears when several declarations match. There is no one-shot command line verb; use query --name for that.

steps: Needs an index of the project
Put the editor caret on the symbol

questions.ask: How do I jump to the declaration of the symbol under my caret?
Where is symbol X declared, from the command line?
